name: franka-full-transfer-v1
scope: Native simulated Franka pick, free-space transfer, slot placement, release and arm withdrawal. This is an articulated arm test, separate from the RGB-D pusher/gauge bench.

arms.D: same mapping plus selective bottom support
arms.Dense: same mapping plus dense bottom support

policy: Shared fixed Cartesian trajectory with native joint feedback; no RGB-D or nodal feedback, no object attachment or imposed pose after initialization.
scoring: All started runs retained. Scene/runtime failures are surfaced separately; no retry/selection by physical result. Score on measured node states and actual joint and hand poses; final window [9.5,10.0] s. Positive whole-object margin, rail penetration <=1 mm, floor support within 1 mm, fingers open and hand at least 100 mm above object top, stable final centroid, positive tet Jacobians. Prior unsupported lift >35 mm with <7 mm relative drift and >40 mm transport required.
timing: Common 10 s physical horizon; synchronized wall-clock rollout including captures; separately report actuation/physics net of instrumentation, captures and readback. Exclude startup and disk export. Record foreign GPU duty; shared-run times are descriptive and not proof of a clean speedup.
rotation_order: Every method appears twice in every order slot; each material receives each first method once.
video_selection: First complete paired cell C01 regardless of outcome. Include all three routes and synchronized capture; archive all case frames.
